obligations.notes: Server image-production obligation. Encoded-byte reception/hash tests do not certify arbitrary source-image processing.

obligations.statement: Pad the remaining image area black.
obligations.condition: Producing artwork for an enabled client channel
obligations.notes: Server image-production obligation. Encoded-byte reception/hash tests do not certify arbitrary source-image processing.

obligations.statement: Do not crop the source image to fill the requested rectangle.
obligations.condition: Producing artwork for an enabled client channel
obligations.notes: Server image-production obligation. Encoded-byte reception/hash tests do not certify arbitrary source-image processing.

obligations.statement: Interpret the stream channels array positionally with omitted trailing channels disabled and at most four entries.
obligations.condition: Receiving artwork stream/start

obligations.statement: Match every effective stream channel configuration to the latest client declaration.
obligations.condition: Receiving artwork stream/start
obligations.notes: Every source/format/size tuple and omitted none position is compared; the client declaration is immutable in this SDK.

obligations.statement: Truncate the echoed channels array after its last streamed channel.
obligations.condition: Choosing the server stream representation
obligations.notes: Recommendation rather than a requirement that the receiver reject redundant trailing none entries.

obligations.statement: Map binary IDs 8 through 11 to artwork channels 0 through 3.
obligations.condition: Parsing artwork binary messages during an active stream
obligations.notes: Authenticated binary IDs 8, 9, 10 and 11 each carry unique bytes through announce/part and are observed only at the matching CurrentArtwork channel; all previously populated channels retain their distinct values. Encoded transport sentinels are not image-renderer or format-content certification.

obligations.statement: Read the announce timestamp as big-endian signed int64 microseconds.
obligations.condition: Parsing artwork binary messages during an active stream
obligations.notes: Targeted byte/shape/sequence evidence. Logical-message validation is separate from Noise carrier fragmentation and from decoding arbitrary image contents.

obligations.statement: Read total_size as big-endian uint32 encoded-image bytes.
obligations.condition: Parsing artwork binary messages during an active stream
obligations.notes: Targeted byte/shape/sequence evidence. Logical-message validation is separate from Noise carrier fragmentation and from decoding arbitrary image contents.

obligations.statement: Keep announce exactly 14 bytes, with no encoded image data in the announce.
obligations.condition: Parsing artwork binary messages during an active stream
obligations.notes: Targeted byte/shape/sequence evidence. Logical-message validation is separate from Noise carrier fragmentation and from decoding arbitrary image contents.

obligations.statement: Keep cancel exactly two bytes.
obligations.condition: Parsing artwork binary messages during an active stream
obligations.notes: Targeted byte/shape/sequence evidence. Logical-message validation is separate from Noise carrier fragmentation and from decoding arbitrary image contents.

obligations.statement: Reject nonzero reserved artwork flag bits or simultaneous announce/cancel bits.
obligations.condition: Parsing artwork binary messages during an active stream
obligations.notes: Targeted byte/shape/sequence evidence. Logical-message validation is separate from Noise carrier fragmentation and from decoding arbitrary image contents.

obligations.statement: Reject artwork messages below two or above 65519 bytes.
obligations.condition: Parsing artwork binary messages during an active stream
obligations.notes: Targeted byte/shape/sequence evidence. Logical-message validation is separate from Noise carrier fragmentation and from decoding arbitrary image contents.

obligations.statement: Concatenate only part data bytes until their sum equals total_size.
obligations.condition: Parsing artwork binary messages during an active stream
obligations.notes: Targeted byte/shape/sequence evidence. Logical-message validation is separate from Noise carrier fragmentation and from decoding arbitrary image contents.

obligations.statement: Complete a zero-size announce immediately without requiring parts.
obligations.condition: Parsing artwork binary messages during an active stream
obligations.notes: Targeted byte/shape/sequence evidence. Logical-message validation is separate from Noise carrier fragmentation and from decoding arbitrary image contents.

obligations.statement: Permit at most one in-flight image transfer across all artwork channels.
obligations.condition: Advancing artwork transfer state
obligations.notes: Unavailable discard still validates this same state machine; there is no per-channel parallel transfer loophole.

obligations.statement: Reject a part without a transfer or on a different channel from the transfer.
obligations.condition: Advancing artwork transfer state
obligations.notes: Unavailable discard still validates this same state machine; there is no per-channel parallel transfer loophole.

obligations.statement: Reject any part whose data exceeds the remaining announced size.
obligations.condition: Advancing artwork transfer state
obligations.notes: Unavailable discard still validates this same state machine; there is no per-channel parallel transfer loophole.

obligations.statement: Cancel an incomplete transfer before announcing its replacement.
obligations.condition: Replacing an in-flight image on any channel
obligations.notes: The receiver closes on an overlapping announce; it does not silently repair missing server cancellation.

obligations.statement: Cancel an incomplete transfer before ending artwork or changing its channel configuration.
obligations.condition: Ending/reconfiguring a partly sent image
obligations.notes: Current immutable channel declarations exclude local layout changes, not this server sequencing duty.

obligations.statement: Allow unrelated messages between artwork transfer parts.
obligations.condition: An artwork transfer remains in flight
obligations.notes: One transfer does not reserve the entire application channel. This is not permission to interleave malformed Sendspin fragment sequences.

obligations.statement: Do not send image messages outside an active artwork stream.
obligations.condition: Sending artwork binary data
obligations.notes: Receiver active-role/stream guards are a separate requirement-checking property.

obligations.statement: Reject recognized artwork data when the role or stream is inactive.
obligations.condition: Receiving recognized IDs 8..11
obligations.notes: Recognition is not lost when a role becomes inactive. No local unavailable exemption weakens sequencing.

obligations.statement: Discard otherwise valid artwork data while unavailable.
obligations.condition: Active artwork stream while local availability is false
obligations.notes: A transfer once discarded is not resurrected as a partial image on availability recovery.

obligations.statement: Do not close solely for valid image data arriving while unavailable.
obligations.condition: Availability updates cross server image sends
obligations.notes: Shape, size, sequence and per-channel activation checks remain mandatory.

obligations.statement: Process announces/cancels and account for every part byte even while discarding images.
obligations.condition: An unavailable transfer is discarded
obligations.notes: No payload allocation is needed, but total_size/overrun and cancellation remain checked.

obligations.statement: Keep current plus at most one pending image independently per channel.
obligations.condition: Applying artwork current/pending state
obligations.notes: Current is distinct from transfer/pending; cancellation is per channel, not a global displayed-image clear.

obligations.statement: Discard a channel's older pending image on its next announce.
obligations.condition: Applying artwork current/pending state
obligations.notes: Current is distinct from transfer/pending; cancellation is per channel, not a global displayed-image clear.

obligations.statement: Cancel pending artwork immediately without changing the current image.
obligations.condition: Applying artwork current/pending state
obligations.notes: Current is distinct from transfer/pending; cancellation is per channel, not a global displayed-image clear.

obligations.statement: Replace, rather than queue, a channel's future scheduled image.
obligations.condition: Applying artwork current/pending state
obligations.notes: Current is distinct from transfer/pending; cancellation is per channel, not a global displayed-image clear.

obligations.statement: Apply an image only after its transfer is complete and its timestamp is due.
obligations.condition: Promoting pending image to current
obligations.notes: Checked clock conversion rejects unrepresentable mappings. Software state publication is not a universal frontend display deadline or physical clock-accuracy proof.

obligations.statement: Translate image time using the current best time-filter estimate without waiting for convergence.
obligations.condition: Promoting pending image to current
obligations.notes: Checked clock conversion rejects unrepresentable mappings. Software state publication is not a universal frontend display deadline or physical clock-accuracy proof.

obligations.statement: Do not drop complete artwork just because its timestamp is late.
obligations.condition: Promoting pending image to current
obligations.notes: Checked clock conversion rejects unrepresentable mappings. Software state publication is not a universal frontend display deadline or physical clock-accuracy proof.

obligations.statement: Represent channel clearing as a zero-size image subject to normal timestamp scheduling.
obligations.condition: Receiving an empty artwork announce
obligations.notes: Future empty images do not clear early; this is distinct from stream/clear, which cannot target artwork.

obligations.statement: Clear current and pending images when artwork ends.
obligations.condition: Receiving stream/end for artwork
obligations.notes: No buffered image finishes after stream/end. Mid-transfer end without prior cancel is a protocol error.

obligations.statement: Clear displayed/pending artwork on role removal.
obligations.condition: Applying explicit/implicit artwork role removal
obligations.notes: The server must first end a live stream. Application-owned image copies already returned cannot be revoked by the SDK.

obligations.statement: Optionally support live client channel-layout changes.
obligations.condition: A product chooses dynamic display layouts
obligations.notes: This SDK's artwork declaration is immutable; no live setter is offered or inferred from receive tests.

obligations.statement: Discard pending image when that channel's stream configuration changes.
obligations.condition: A selected live-layout change reaches stream/start
obligations.notes: Conditional client behavior of the unselected live-layout feature; immutable declarations require exact matching instead.

obligations.statement: Update a changed live channel configuration with stream/start and immediately resend images for changed enabled channels.
obligations.condition: Client channel declaration changes during an active stream
obligations.notes: No stream is started solely because idle state changed; changed enabled channels receive a new image.

obligations.statement: Clear a channel with a past/present zero-size announce before setting its source to none.
obligations.condition: Disabling an active artwork channel
obligations.notes: Configuration disabling is not itself a scheduled displayed-image clear.

obligations.statement: Resend a still-applicable pending image after changing its channel configuration.
obligations.condition: A configuration update invalidates pending representation
obligations.notes: The receiver's prior pending image is not carried across a changed encoding/layout.

obligations.statement: Bound local announced encoded-image storage without eager total_size allocation.
obligations.condition: Applying Config.MaxMessageBytes to total_size
obligations.notes: Local resource policy, not a protocol-advertised artwork capacity. Otherwise-valid larger images may be refused. Caller/event/current/pending copies and decoded rendering memory are additional costs.

obligations.statement: Promptly send current artwork after initial/reconnected stream/start for each enabled channel.
obligations.condition: Serving a late-joining artwork client
obligations.notes: Reference traces do not exhaust every late-join case or impose a client image-request API.

obligations.statement: Send the current image before re-sending its future scheduled successor after a late join.
obligations.condition: Both current and future scheduled images exist at stream start
obligations.notes: Reverse order would discard the future schedule under the normal receiver replacement rule.

obligations.statement: Pace artwork parts rather than sending them all back to back.
obligations.condition: Transferring multi-part artwork alongside other roles
obligations.notes: Concurrent-audio fairness/load measurements are not implied by functional image reception.

obligations.statement: Avoid scheduling an artwork announce more than 20 seconds ahead.
obligations.condition: Sending a future image
obligations.notes: Sender lead recommendation, not a client rejection boundary.

obligations.statement: Send a second sequential scheduled image only after the first timestamp has passed on the server clock.
obligations.condition: Both images should actually be displayed
obligations.notes: Otherwise the client replaces its one pending image.

obligations.statement: Optionally ease into a complete pending image or show it early.
obligations.condition: Host selects a coming-up/cross-fade renderer
obligations.notes: The library exposes applied encoded images and does not select a universal renderer.

obligations.statement: Use plain ws:// for the WebSocket transport, not direct TLS.
obligations.condition: Opening an inbound or outbound connection
obligations.notes: Noise supplies confidentiality/integrity; external TLS termination/proxy deployment is application-owned.

obligations.statement: Do not follow redirects that can change the selected WebSocket endpoint or transport.
obligations.condition: Outbound HTTP upgrade is redirected
obligations.notes: SDK security policy supporting plain-transport/identity boundaries, not a new independent wire MUST prohibiting every proxy architecture.

obligations.statement: Advertise client service _sendspin._tcp.local. on the actual listening port.
obligations.condition: Serving with SDK-owned advertisement
obligations.notes: Isolated real IPv4 DNS-SD tests; disabling SDK advertisement makes external publication the embedding application's responsibility.

obligations.statement: Include the required WebSocket path TXT key in client advertisement.
obligations.condition: Serving with SDK-owned advertisement
obligations.notes: Isolated real IPv4 DNS-SD tests; disabling SDK advertisement makes external publication the embedding application's responsibility.

obligations.statement: Prefer the recommended listener port 8928 and path /sendspin when selecting defaults.
obligations.condition: Choosing a deployment's default listener configuration
obligations.notes: The SDK now exposes the explicit recommended :8928 address and default /sendspin path; Serve mounts and advertises the same path constant. A loopback listener on an ephemeral port proves the actual handler route without host multicast or occupying a fixed service port. Serve still accepts caller-chosen listener addresses and does not bind a port implicitly.

obligations.statement: Optionally include a friendly discovery name.
obligations.condition: Name fits a DNS TXT string
obligations.notes: Overlong optional names are omitted instead of breaking mandatory discovery path publication.

obligations.statement: Make an advertised name hint match client/hello name; hello remains authoritative on mismatch.
obligations.condition: Providing the client TXT name hint
obligations.notes: The SDK uses the same configured friendly name. Server interpretation of mismatches is separately external.

obligations.statement: Discover and connect to clients using their advertised address/path and treat hello name as authoritative.
obligations.condition: Server-initiated discovery/identity presentation
obligations.notes: The client advertiser does not implement a Sendspin server browser.

obligations.statement: Release only SDK-owned listener/advertisement/browser/handler lifetimes before relinquishing mode.
obligations.condition: Cancellation, startup failure or mode transition
obligations.notes: Local ownership supports mode exclusion. Native interface changes, OS socket behavior and arbitrary blocking callbacks are not certified by this isolated suite.

obligations.statement: Discover _sendspin-server._tcp.local. and connect using its advertised address, port and required path.
obligations.condition: Client-initiated IPv4 discovery
obligations.notes: Missing/malformed paths are ignored; exact request target is preserved. Real multicast runs only inside the isolated container runner.

obligations.statement: Treat server/hello as authoritative over a DNS friendly-name hint.
obligations.condition: Discovery and encrypted hello names differ
obligations.notes: Snapshot uses hello, not unauthenticated discovery metadata, as server name.

obligations.statement: Establish discovery over scoped IPv6 link-local and changing native interfaces.
obligations.condition: Target deployment depends on those discovery paths
obligations.notes: The source-pinned private mDNS transport rejects foreign/unknown kernel interface indices before record parsing/query dispatch; its Windows UDP packet-info adapter has native loopback tests. Browsing and per-interface publication reconcile topology changes without migrating TCP listeners. The isolated hotplug test observes both existing wildcard listener families from the added network (IPv6 observer in a separate namespace), validates scope/encrypted connection and requires socket cleanup. Snapshot/registration failure, retry, cancellation and immutable address/family/interface restrictions have focused unit tests. This does not establish native Windows/macOS multicast hotplug, arbitrary reflectors/VLANs or universal deployment behavior; the platform/network disposition remains open.

obligations.statement: Advertise server discovery service _sendspin-server._tcp.local. at its real listening port.
obligations.condition: Advertising a server for client-initiated discovery
obligations.notes: Server-side DNS-SD policy. Independent server TXT observations are interop evidence, not complete remote sender certification.

obligations.statement: Include the required server WebSocket path TXT key.
obligations.condition: Advertising a server for client-initiated discovery
obligations.notes: Server-side DNS-SD policy. Independent server TXT observations are interop evidence, not complete remote sender certification.

obligations.statement: Prefer server listener port 8927 and WebSocket path /sendspin.
obligations.condition: Advertising a server for client-initiated discovery
obligations.notes: Server-side DNS-SD policy. Independent server TXT observations are interop evidence, not complete remote sender certification.

obligations.statement: Optionally publish a friendly server name hint.
obligations.condition: Advertising a server for client-initiated discovery
obligations.notes: Server-side DNS-SD policy. Independent server TXT observations are interop evidence, not complete remote sender certification.

obligations.statement: Keep server TXT name consistent with server/hello; hello is authoritative.
obligations.condition: Advertising a server for client-initiated discovery
obligations.notes: Server-side DNS-SD policy. Independent server TXT observations are interop evidence, not complete remote sender certification.

obligations.statement: Select among discovered outbound servers with implementation-defined policy.
obligations.condition: More than one server may be discoverable
obligations.notes: DiscoverAndRun uses the first usable endpoint; Browse/Run allow host selection. No protocol-mandated selection UI or automatic roaming is invented.

obligations.statement: Run the same post-connection protocol independent of WebSocket initiation direction.
obligations.condition: Either supported connection direction
obligations.notes: Same Noise responder and actor handle both; this does not prove native runtime behavior on every target platform.

obligations.statement: Support at least one of the two defined suites.
obligations.condition: Creating a client configuration
obligations.notes: Both ChaChaPoly and AESGCM are implemented; this exceeds the minimum, without new suite negotiation.

obligations.statement: Pick and announce exactly one suite in client/init, without negotiation.
obligations.condition: Starting a connection
obligations.notes: Suite is fixed for that connection and carried over during rekey.

obligations.statement: Support both defined cipher suites on the server.
obligations.condition: Implementing a conforming server
obligations.notes: Client support for both suites does not certify every other server.

obligations.statement: Encode public identities as 43-character unpadded Base64URL Curve25519 keys.
obligations.condition: Sending client identity or accepting server identity
obligations.notes: Canonical wire syntax is checked before resolution; operator token leniency does not apply.

obligations.statement: Generate private identity keys per device using a CSPRNG, not a shared fixed default.
obligations.condition: Initializing new credentials
obligations.notes: Focused source-policy inspection checks private key generation receives crypto/rand.Reader and independent per-device generation catches fixed/reused/zero secrets and identities. This is not a cryptographic primitive or physical entropy certification.

obligations.statement: Treat static keys as long-lived identity; rotation changes identity rather than silently migrating trust.
obligations.condition: Restarting the SDK or replacing its credential store
obligations.notes: Identity is the public key. Preserving a server across migration requires that server's private-key backup, not a name match.

obligations.statement: Draw server identity private keys from a per-device CSPRNG, not a shared default.
obligations.condition: Provisioning a Sendspin server
obligations.notes: No server identity generator is shipped in this client SDK.

obligations.statement: Derive each psk_id as SHA256 of the exact UTF-8 sendspin-psk-id-v1 label followed by raw PSK.
obligations.condition: Resolving message-1 PSK selection
obligations.notes: Category miss differs from post-match identity misbinding. Sentinel is public, not authenticated operator identity.

obligations.statement: Select a candidate only under the declared lt/pr/sn category.
obligations.condition: Resolving message-1 PSK selection
obligations.notes: Category miss differs from post-match identity misbinding. Sentinel is public, not authenticated operator identity.

obligations.statement: Use the published SHA256 sendspin-sentinel-psk-v1 Sentinel and its defined identifier.
obligations.condition: Resolving message-1 PSK selection
obligations.notes: Category miss differs from post-match identity misbinding. Sentinel is public, not authenticated operator identity.

obligations.statement: After a long-term hash match verify the stored server identity against server/init.
obligations.condition: Resolving message-1 PSK selection
obligations.notes: Category miss differs from post-match identity misbinding. Sentinel is public, not authenticated operator identity.

obligations.statement: Treat message-1 payload as encrypted before PSK mixing, with PSK mixed only at KKpsk2 message two.
obligations.condition: Parsing the selection hint before responding
obligations.notes: Handshake construction property, not independent cryptographic assurance or protection of message-1 contents after static-key compromise.

obligations.statement: Fall back to Sentinel on initial category/identifier lookup miss only.
obligations.condition: No candidate matches the initial declared category
obligations.notes: A rekey miss or failed stored-server post-match check fails instead; fallback does not delete trust.

obligations.statement: Do not delete or replace pairing records because of credential-mismatch fallback alone.
obligations.condition: An initial session proceeds under Sentinel
obligations.notes: Explicit completed repair/unpair is different from automatic credential erasure.

obligations.statement: Retry the same second handshake message under Sentinel after referenced non-Sentinel verification fails.
obligations.condition: Checking initial credential-mismatch fallback
obligations.notes: No extra retry message or second client handshake is introduced.

obligations.statement: Do not activate roles or playback on fallback while the server still holds its mismatching record.
obligations.condition: A referenced long-term record exists on the server
obligations.notes: Pairing or idle is allowed; local unpaired enablement alone does not override the remote record constraint.

obligations.statement: Surface credential mismatch and offer operator re-pairing.
obligations.condition: A Sentinel fallback proves the client cannot use the credential
obligations.notes: Dedicated server UI guidance, not a client-side trust deletion decision.

obligations.statement: Tolerate valid old-key client application messages before receiving Noise message two.
obligations.condition: Old client sends cross server's rekey message one
obligations.notes: Opposite directions can cross. The SDK client pauses new writes when it receives message one.

obligations.statement: Optionally discard valid old-key applications without responding during that rekey window.
obligations.condition: Server receives permitted old-key client traffic
obligations.notes: Clock requests may need restarting; tolerance does not require processing every old request.

obligations.statement: Preserve open player stream and already decoded buffered audio across in-band rekey.
obligations.condition: Sentinel-to-pairing-to-long-term key promotion
obligations.notes: Blocked and queued chunks survive two actual rekeys without flush/reopen/redecode. Paused virtual output proves lifecycle ownership, not elapsed-time/hardware timing.

obligations.statement: Preserve time-filter estimates while restarting requests that may be discarded by the rekeying server.
obligations.condition: Installing new transport keys
obligations.notes: Only outstanding request bookkeeping restarts; it does not reset learned drift/offset.

obligations.statement: Preserve presentation streams, current/pending states and decoded visualization data through rekey.
obligations.condition: In-band rekey without explicit role removal
obligations.notes: Both suites perform two real old-key/new-key exchanges with pending metadata/color, complete pending artwork, another channel in-flight, and decoded loudness/spectrum queued. New-key sticky-role activations preserve all of them; the old transfer completes with new-key parts and due states/queued values apply once in order. Directly driven actor/virtual clock, shared Noise primitive: not native aiosendspin, elapsed-time scheduling, hardware timing or stress evidence.

obligations.statement: Declare the minimal current-purpose activities and drop each when its purpose ends.
obligations.condition: Updating connection purpose for cooperative admission
obligations.notes: The SDK ranks declared admissible sets and does not infer a hidden server purpose or invent another priority model.

obligations.statement: Begin the connection with client/init and complete initial server/init, Noise, hello, activation order.
obligations.condition: Initial protocol establishment
obligations.notes: One initial phase grammar. Wrong phase/direction closes; no application role is needed for the grammar.

obligations.statement: Carry each cleartext handshake envelope as a complete WebSocket text message.
obligations.condition: Initial client/init and client Noise response
obligations.notes: Cleartext transport does not permit concatenated application records or a Noise-encrypted initial carrier.

obligations.statement: Carry each post-Noise application message as one WebSocket binary Noise transport message.
obligations.condition: Encrypted transport mode
obligations.notes: Carrier size/AEAD and application reassembly are separate checks; cleartext is not a fallback after activation.

obligations.statement: Operate on complete WebSocket messages, independently of RFC 6455 frame fragmentation.
obligations.condition: Reading/writing fragmented WebSocket carriers
obligations.notes: Real masked/unmasked carrier trackers cover failure completion. This is not native socket congestion/backpressure measurement.

obligations.statement: Allow WebSocket control frames independently of the Noise/application phase.
obligations.condition: RFC 6455 Ping/Pong/Close between application messages
obligations.notes: Actual Ping/Pong control frames are exercised before init response, between init and Noise, after Noise/before hello, after activation and during the rekey activation barrier, under both suites/directions. A proper RFC Close completes the trace; none is treated as Noise/application data.

obligations.statement: Do not start client application messages before initial activation.
obligations.condition: Before receiving the initial server/activate
obligations.notes: Handshake/hello and the optional encrypted goodbye exception are classified separately.

obligations.statement: Optionally send encrypted goodbye once the initial Noise handshake has completed.
obligations.condition: Closing before the initial activation
obligations.notes: No general pre-hello application API is offered. The exception is a permission, never an obligation to send on silent failures.

obligations.statement: Do not send other server messages before initial activation except the defined init-failure error.
obligations.condition: Initial server sequencing
obligations.notes: Receiver phase barriers reject unexpected messages, but do not certify another server's complete send policy.

obligations.statement: Apply unknown-message ignore only after initial activation.
obligations.condition: Unknown JSON or binary arrives
obligations.notes: A well-formed unknown type is not permission to bypass the initial handshake/activation barrier.

obligations.statement: Require valid UTF-8 JSON object with a string type and an object payload.
obligations.condition: Parsing any recognized or unknown JSON envelope
obligations.notes: Invalid encoding is rejected even in otherwise unknown fields; unknown strings need not contain slash or be nonempty.

obligations.statement: Ignore any unrecognized type string in an otherwise valid envelope after activation.
obligations.condition: Post-activation unknown JSON type
obligations.notes: Forward compatibility does not make a malformed envelope ignorable.

obligations.statement: Ignore unrecognized exact-case payload keys without validating their bodies as known fields.
obligations.condition: Parsing an otherwise valid known message
obligations.notes: Unknown keys do not satisfy differently cased required fields. Optional means omitted, not null accepted unconditionally. Regression: stream/end does not impose stream/clear timestamp typing on an unknown server_transmitted key.

obligations.statement: Keep known-field value, direction, authentication and sequencing checks despite extension tolerance.
obligations.condition: Known message includes unknown keys or unknown values in known fields
obligations.notes: A field's own ignore rule, such as inactive pairing/unoffered player commands, takes precedence only where explicitly specified.

obligations.statement: Send only fields defined for the chosen message, except explicitly permitted application-role objects.
obligations.condition: Serializing outgoing SDK protocol messages
obligations.notes: An AST inventory guards every production outgoing message discriminator/bridge. The independent scripted-peer reader enforces the explicit allowed envelope/payload/nested fields for all emitted message families throughout the suite; exact hello/state/command/core/pairing assertions inspect actual values. No unadvertised custom/future fields are added by silence.

obligations.statement: Confirm support before sending a future feature except its negotiation/informational exemption.
obligations.condition: Selecting a protocol profile outside pinned RC1
obligations.notes: This SDK rejects unsupported profiles rather than inventing a future negotiation mechanism. No future feature implementation is claimed.

obligations.statement: Do not treat lack of an error as evidence of peer feature support.
obligations.condition: Reasoning about unnegotiated extensions
obligations.notes: Unknown messages/support-looking fields can be ignored without error but grant no outgoing command permission. A real permitted command still works afterward; unsupported local profiles/roles fail before storage. The SDK documents no implicit future-feature negotiation or no-error discovery API.

obligations.statement: Authenticate and enforce fragment/role checks even when discarding binary role payloads.
obligations.condition: Unknown/unavailable/late binary data is discarded
obligations.notes: Actual encrypted unknown-ID discard and active-but-unavailable player-role fragmented input both enforce continuation AEAD and sequence validity, with actual public handler closure/no state leaks. Independent native valid unavailable data and artwork part accounting remain separate positive checks.

obligations.statement: Keep implemented IDs recognized when their role is inactive.
obligations.condition: Receiving a known role binary ID without active permission
obligations.notes: Exhaustive registry excludes transport ID 1, which is consumed by reassembly; role-range allocation does not implement every ID.

obligations.statement: Split payloads exceeding one 65535-byte Noise carrier across fragment messages.
obligations.condition: Sending or receiving Sendspin fragmentation
obligations.notes: Per-direction state; RFC 6455 frame fragmentation is separate. Tests establish software grammar/failure completion, not arbitrary kernel I/O behavior.

obligations.statement: Use first-fragment orig_type and first/last flag bits with reserved bits zero.
obligations.condition: Sending or receiving Sendspin fragmentation
obligations.notes: Literal expected first/continuation/last bytes and original IDs 0/4/8/16/255 are checked without using Push as an oracle. Independent 65519/65535 carrier limits, exact two/three-fragment transitions and payload slices establish reserved-zero flags and boundaries.

obligations.statement: Finish one fragmented send before any other binary send in that direction.
obligations.condition: Sending or receiving Sendspin fragmentation
obligations.notes: Per-direction state; RFC 6455 frame fragmentation is separate. Tests establish software grammar/failure completion, not arbitrary kernel I/O behavior.

obligations.statement: Do not fragment a message that fits a single Noise transport message.
obligations.condition: Sending or receiving Sendspin fragmentation
obligations.notes: Sizes 1, 2, 65518 and 65519 produce exactly one unchanged carrier; the first oversized case produces fixed expected fragments. Counting emissions closes the former symmetric-roundtrip proof gap.

obligations.statement: Never use fragmentation ID 1 as orig_type.
obligations.condition: Sending or receiving Sendspin fragmentation
obligations.notes: Empty inputs and original ID 1, including oversized input, return ErrProtocol before the emission callback is invoked. Receiver rejection is no longer used as evidence of the sender guard.

obligations.statement: Reassemble one original payload and dispatch it once upon the last fragment.
obligations.condition: Sending or receiving Sendspin fragmentation
obligations.notes: Per-direction state; RFC 6455 frame fragmentation is separate. Tests establish software grammar/failure completion, not arbitrary kernel I/O behavior.

obligations.statement: Track and authenticate unknown-ID fragments without dispatching the discarded message.
obligations.condition: Sending or receiving Sendspin fragmentation
obligations.notes: A first unknown-ID fragment starts discard tracking; a tampered last continuation still fails authentication and a nested first still fails sequencing. Both suites/directions close actual handlers, rather than combining unrelated unit results into an assumed conjunction.

obligations.statement: Close on nested first fragments, orphan continuations, interleaving, reserved flags or recursive orig_type.
obligations.condition: Sending or receiving Sendspin fragmentation
obligations.notes: Per-direction state; RFC 6455 frame fragmentation is separate. Tests establish software grammar/failure completion, not arbitrary kernel I/O behavior.

obligations.statement: Optionally discard unknown orig_type fragment data without allocating a full payload buffer.
obligations.condition: Reassembling an unimplemented binary type
obligations.notes: The local total-message resource cap still applies. A placeholder discriminator reaches generic ignore dispatch but no discarded application body is delivered.

obligations.statement: Send clock requests frequently enough to keep the time filter convergent.
obligations.condition: Maintaining an active synchronized connection
obligations.notes: Eight-sample bursts and adaptive timing exist; a known-good example strategy is not a universal MUST. Functional reference convergence is not convergence under expected network/load/device conditions. Native Windows regression: coarse runtime time readings could quantize fast loopback RTT to zero. QPC-backed process time is now used consistently at transmit/arrival and scheduling boundaries, with exact overflow-safe conversion and no fabricated positive RTT. Unconverged startup does not enter the ten-second steady-state pause after invalid bursts. Native startup evidence is not physical accuracy, load or universal deployment convergence evidence.

obligations.statement: Feed four application-boundary timestamps to the required offset/drift filter.
obligations.condition: Accepting a correlated server/time response
obligations.notes: Pinned algorithm parity does not establish physical clock/output accuracy.

obligations.statement: Do not report player available until its filter is ready for scheduling.
obligations.condition: Sending player availability before/after synchronization
obligations.notes: Actual encrypted state payloads are independently compared for all 64 active-role subsets before filter readiness and after three controlled samples. Player configurations advertise unavailable before readiness; non-player readiness is not incorrectly gated. No physical convergence/accuracy claim follows.

obligations.statement: Do not report source available before capture-clock convergence.
obligations.condition: A product selects optional source capture
obligations.notes: Source capture is deliberately unimplemented/unadvertised; its permission is recorded below. Player readiness is not evidence of timestamped capture behavior.

obligations.statement: Stamp server_transmitted/send_ahead after application queueing immediately before encryption.
obligations.condition: Sending timestamped application data
obligations.notes: Transport buffering/link contention after encryption is network delay, not a value the SDK can subtract from the sender stamp.

obligations.statement: Capture transit arrival after decryption and whole-message reassembly, before observer/actor delay.
obligations.condition: Measuring application-boundary arrival
obligations.notes: ReadTimed captures before observers and actor handoff. This does not measure kernel receipt or exclude ordinary scheduling uncertainty. Native Windows regression: coarse runtime time readings could quantize fast loopback RTT to zero. QPC-backed process time is now used consistently at transmit/arrival and scheduling boundaries, with exact overflow-safe conversion and no fabricated positive RTT. Unconverged startup does not enter the ten-second steady-state pause after invalid bursts. Native startup evidence is not physical accuracy, load or universal deployment convergence evidence.

obligations.statement: Implement core message handling independently of the selected application roles.
obligations.condition: Operating a no-role or non-player session
obligations.notes: A no-application-role encrypted trace performs init/hello/activation, exact clock/leave/group/state/command, real rekey, mandatory PSK attempt/cancellation and unpaired-unpair ignore; recognized wrong-direction/phase/lifecycle messages are still rejected. Native paired unpair/no-role clock/leave and inactive start checks provide separate paths. Source capture internals remain deliberately unsupported.

obligations.statement: Implement all core and all pairing messages on the server regardless of roles.
obligations.condition: Implementing a Sendspin server
obligations.notes: Core role-specific internals are required only where that role is supported. A client SDK cannot certify full server message support.

obligations.statement: Process stream/start, clear and end in delivery order even while discarding role data.
obligations.condition: Receiving lifecycle messages including while unavailable
obligations.notes: One actor processes acknowledged input in order; source client-stream lifecycle is a separate server duty.

obligations.statement: Process client-stream start/end in delivery order.
obligations.condition: Receiving source capture lifecycle
obligations.notes: This server-side duty remains outside the client SDK's frozen default profile. Opt-in source-client extension tests use the independent server and do not promote this server assessment.

obligations.notes: Protocol framing/schema and both-suite positive/negative controls; peers share the Noise primitive, not SDK framing. Core version is not the specification release or role version.

obligations.statement: Require server/init static public server_id and exact core version 1.
obligations.condition: Initial or in-band Noise exchange

obligations.statement: Validate the decrypted message-1 object, 32-byte psk_id and one of lt/pr/sn categories.
obligations.condition: Initial or in-band Noise exchange
obligations.notes: Protocol framing/schema and both-suite positive/negative controls; peers share the Noise primitive, not SDK framing. Core version is not the specification release or role version.

obligations.statement: Use literal UTF-8 {} as the encrypted Noise message-2 payload.
obligations.condition: Initial or in-band Noise exchange
obligations.notes: Protocol framing/schema and both-suite positive/negative controls; peers share the Noise primitive, not SDK framing. Core version is not the specification release or role version.

obligations.statement: Switch to binary Noise transport after exchanging the two initial handshake messages.
obligations.condition: Initial or in-band Noise exchange
obligations.notes: Protocol framing/schema and both-suite positive/negative controls; peers share the Noise primitive, not SDK framing. Core version is not the specification release or role version.

obligations.statement: Carry rekey handshake messages as encrypted JSON under old transport keys until key installation.
obligations.condition: Initial or in-band Noise exchange
obligations.notes: Protocol framing/schema and both-suite positive/negative controls; peers share the Noise primitive, not SDK framing. Core version is not the specification release or role version.

obligations.statement: Send server/init immediately followed by Noise message 1 without awaiting a client message.
obligations.condition: Accepting a valid client/init
obligations.notes: Sender sequencing is not a negotiated extra client request.

obligations.statement: Treat server/error as an unauthenticated init failure hint and stop without mutating trust.
obligations.condition: Receiving server/error instead of server/init
obligations.notes: No credential deletion/selection or protocol downgrade follows unauthenticated reason text; this client does not claim a detailed reason logging API.

obligations.statement: Require a string server name before sending client/hello.
obligations.condition: Receiving the first encrypted server hello
obligations.notes: Duplicate/wrong-phase hello is a protocol error; empty names are not prohibited by an invented nonempty-string rule.

obligations.statement: When languages is present require a nonempty ordered list of structurally valid BCP47 tags.
obligations.condition: Receiving language preferences
obligations.notes: Structural RFC5646 validation, not a pinned registry/extension-semantic lookup. Preference spelling/order/duplicates remain verbatim.

obligations.statement: Preserve the received language preference hint across re-handshake without re-sending hello.
obligations.condition: Exposing Snapshot.ServerLanguages
obligations.notes: Owned snapshot slices prevent caller mutation. Supporting hints is not dynamic speech-pairing implementation.

obligations.statement: Validate the known source support outer object without interpreting unsupported source internals.
obligations.condition: A server hello contains source@v1_support
obligations.notes: The frozen default profile does not advertise source and validates the known outer support object without interpreting source-version internals. Opt-in source negotiation is implemented and tested separately against the same specification pin; it does not promote primary profile fulfillment.

obligations.statement: Optionally advertise the source role when implementing source capture.
obligations.condition: Selecting supported application roles
obligations.notes: Declarative capability choice, not an explicit uppercase MAY in this bullet. Source is outside the frozen default profile; the separately enabled source extension is now implemented. Mandatory core messages and the unchanged primary assessments remain separate from extension evidence.

obligations.statement: Send one encrypted client hello after the initial server hello, not on rekey.
obligations.condition: Completing initial capability advertisement
obligations.notes: No repeated hello is used as a runtime configuration update.

obligations.statement: Offer player for audio-capable client configurations.
obligations.condition: Configuring a product that can output audio
obligations.notes: Audio-capable default configuration offers player and rejects a missing required output. Explicit host-selected roles remain local policy; this SHOULD is not turned into a forced player role on controller-only products.

obligations.statement: Send name and ordered versioned supported_roles with matching required support-object keys.
obligations.condition: Serializing a supported client configuration
obligations.notes: All 64 supported-role subsets under both suites have exact decrypted hello maps, fixed capability values, preference order, optional name/device data and PSK-only policy. Support keys appear iff their role is offered; unoffered source/custom support objects are absent. This directly driven scripted-peer test shares the Noise primitive, not SDK framing.

obligations.statement: Optionally include typed device information in hello.
obligations.condition: Config.DeviceInfo is supplied
obligations.notes: All eight combinations of the three optional DeviceInfo strings, plus nil DeviceInfo, have exact observed encrypted output. Empty optional fields are omitted; a configured empty object stays an object. No MAC output is implemented or claimed.

obligations.statement: Offer at most one code-based pairing method in addition to mandatory pairing_psk.
obligations.condition: Sending supported_pair_methods
obligations.notes: Only pairing_psk:{} is emitted; zero code methods is not support for either optional flow.

obligations.statement: Do not activate a role version requiring a missing hello support object.
obligations.condition: Choosing active role versions
obligations.notes: Client correct support advertisement does not certify remote selection behavior.

obligations.statement: Require activities as a unique unordered set of playback/pairing, allowing empty.
obligations.condition: Receiving activation
obligations.notes: Malformed duplicate/unknown/type cases fail before admission or trust mutation.

obligations.statement: Treat omitted active_roles on first activation as empty; preserve later omission while playback-capable.
obligations.condition: An activation omits active_roles
obligations.notes: First omitted roles are directly tested as empty. Later explicit same-version and omitted sticky roles remain exactly equal across ordinary activations and two real rekeys; rekey does not turn the subsequent activation into a new first activation.

obligations.statement: Send active_roles on the first activation and keep it empty when not playback-capable.
obligations.condition: Sending an activation
obligations.notes: Receiver tolerance for first omission does not remove the sender's explicit presence duty.

obligations.statement: Validate matched-PSK activities and nonempty role admissibility, including unpaired local policy.
obligations.condition: Evaluating every activation before admission
obligations.notes: lt permits idle/playback only; sn/pr pairing/playback is constrained by local policy and method binding. Activity declaration is distinct from role activation.

obligations.statement: Implicitly clear persisted roles when omitted roles are no longer playback-capable.
obligations.condition: Activities or rekey matched-PSK category change
obligations.notes: Actual new-key lt/pr/sn activations test sticky roles under both access policies, including accepted idle/pairing transitions that implicitly clear old nonempty roles and current/pending states without an explicit role field. Denied explicit roles and refusal precedence are separately checked.

obligations.statement: Prefer pairing_required only when enabling local unpaired access would make the whole activation admissible.
obligations.condition: Selecting the first applicable activation refusal
obligations.notes: Otherwise unauthorized precedes unsupported-method abort. These are ordered outcomes, not speculative peer trust repairs.

obligations.statement: Check actual active roles rather than assume every supported role was activated.
obligations.condition: Executing a role-specific operation
obligations.notes: Supported capabilities do not grant active permission; unsupported versions/families are rejected.

obligations.statement: Optionally omit a supported role from activation under server policy.
obligations.condition: Selecting active roles
obligations.notes: Preferred role-version selection additionally depends on README definitions outside this nine-document inventory.

obligations.statement: Ignore the entire pairing field when activities does not include pairing.
obligations.condition: Receiving non-pairing activation
obligations.notes: Field-specific explicit ignore includes shape; it does not weaken general known-field null/type validation.

obligations.statement: Require a typed method object during pairing and require format for dynamic pairing.
obligations.condition: Receiving activation that includes pairing
obligations.notes: Malformed mandatory fields close silently before any PSK reveal; well-typed unoffered method/format follows explicit abort.

obligations.statement: Bind pairing_psk selection iff the matched category is pairing and select only offered method/format.
obligations.condition: Checking a pairing activation
obligations.notes: No emission format is offered for pairing_psk. Code-flow internals are not implemented merely by rejecting method selection.

obligations.statement: Select qr_code only if the server operator interface can scan QR codes.
obligations.condition: Choosing dynamic pairing emission format
obligations.notes: A server UX capability requirement, not a request to add a scanner or QR display to this SDK.

obligations.statement: End active server-to-client streams before removing their role, before rekey if the next activation removes it.
obligations.condition: Explicit/implicit/version-change role removal
obligations.notes: Client detects missing stream/end rather than silently treating it as a conforming role update.

obligations.statement: Stop remaining stream-role output, clear buffers and release temporary effects on role removal.
obligations.condition: Removing player/artwork/visualizer after stream completion
obligations.notes: All supported role state/current/pending/buffers/decoders are absent after completed stream ends and role removal; native blocked/queued player cancellation and visualizer removal cover live output. No ducking feature is offered, no unsupported custom-role completion is inferred, and physical stop latency remains unmeasured.

obligations.statement: Send an initial client/state whenever active_roles is nonempty, even for state-less roles.
obligations.condition: Completing activation with nonempty roles
obligations.notes: The real activation dispatcher emits initial state for every nonempty active-role subset, including controller/metadata/color-only combinations with available but no role object. Empty roles are separately exercised via an explicit sendState, not claimed to require an unsolicited initial state.

obligations.statement: Include each newly added/re-added role's client state before that role's binary data is expected.
obligations.condition: Activation adds a role with client/state
obligations.notes: Explicit activation/deactivation/readdition sequences observe full player/artwork/visualizer objects only for the new current set, including retained player format preference. The tests inspect the first resulting encrypted message, not merely peer acceptance. Remote waiting before binary data remains server-owned.

obligations.statement: Include available and each included role's full state in every client/state update.
obligations.condition: Reporting changed operational/role state
obligations.notes: Exact full maps for all active-role subsets cover required availability, all supported state objects, zero-valued spectrum f_min and preference presence/absence. Repeated emission after convergence, willingness, preference and reactivation is checked; native command evidence separately covers volume/mute/delay changes. No future unsupported-role schema is inferred.

obligations.statement: Do not include client-state objects for inactive roles.
obligations.condition: Sending client/state after role changes
obligations.notes: All 64 active subsets and repeated deactivation/readdition prove exact omission of inactive state objects. A stored player preference cannot leak a player object while that role is inactive.

obligations.statement: Wait for required role state before sending role binary data; use latest availability for reactivated state-less roles.
obligations.condition: Opening a role's binary channel
obligations.notes: Opposite-direction availability races do not authorize the client to reject valid in-flight data solely for unavailable state.

obligations.statement: Do not end a stream solely because local availability changes.
obligations.condition: Calling SetAvailable(false)
obligations.notes: Local output may flush/discard; stream lifecycle remains governed by ordered server messages.

obligations.statement: Remain available for an external activity that Sendspin may interrupt at any time.
obligations.condition: Host classifies an interruptible external activity
obligations.notes: Reviewed SDK integration contract: the host classifies whether external use is interruptible and keeps SetAvailable(true) while willing to yield; the SDK cannot infer HDMI/source ownership. No automatic detector is required by M:321. This closes the API/ownership interpretation only, not a claim about an unidentified physical product's willingness to yield. An embedding product must review its real activity policy using the checklist in rc1-review-decisions.md.

obligations.statement: Optionally leave the playing group while performing interruptible external activity.
obligations.condition: Application elects to stop participating without becoming unavailable
obligations.notes: LeaveGroup is explicit; stopped groups need not be left automatically.

obligations.statement: Report unavailable only while unwilling to yield and restore available promptly when willing again.
obligations.condition: Host controls a noninterruptible external activity
obligations.notes: Reviewed SDK integration contract: the host reports SetAvailable(false) only while it is unwilling to yield, then restores true promptly when willing again. The SDK forwards this choice subject to its own readiness gates; no physical-activity detector or universal timing bound for host actions is implied. This closes the responsibility interpretation, not product-level yield/timing evidence. See the integration checklist in rc1-review-decisions.md.

obligations.statement: Promptly send full current state on role addition/readdition and do not activate until complete state is available.
obligations.condition: Bringing a server-state role online
obligations.notes: If complete state becomes unavailable, deactivate the role; receiver parsing cannot prove server knowledge or promptness.

obligations.statement: Promptly report changes to active role state, without redundant scheduled/progress-advance updates.
obligations.condition: An active server-state field changes
obligations.notes: Scheduled taking-effect and ordinary progress advance need no new message.

obligations.statement: Send server-state objects only for active roles.
obligations.condition: Producing server/state
obligations.notes: The client validates recognized inactive-role objects, unlike the server's explicit tolerance for old in-flight client objects.

obligations.statement: Optionally include permitted application-specific server-state objects.
obligations.condition: Server implements an advertised application-specific role
obligations.notes: No custom-role receiver is advertised by this SDK; payload unknown-key handling remains core forward compatibility.

obligations.statement: Treat stream/start for an active stream as a configuration update rather than an end.

Both old and new audio formats render exact samples; identical immutable artwork configuration does not reset its transfer.

obligations.statement: Require integer server_transmitted and active role objects on stream/start.
obligations.condition: Receiving stream/start
obligations.notes: The core start wrapper has explicit missing/null/type/overflow/integer-boundary timestamp checks for each supported stream object, inactive-role rejection and valid unavailable reception. These assertions are independent of successful format negotiation alone.

obligations.statement: Do not send stream/start unless the latest received client availability is true.
obligations.condition: Starting/updating a server-to-client stream
obligations.notes: The receiver's local current availability may have changed after the server's latest report.

obligations.statement: Derive each stream configuration from constant hello capabilities and current required role state.
obligations.condition: Selecting initial/re-added/changed active stream configuration
obligations.notes: A state change updates an existing stream only if its configuration changed; no idle stream starts in response.

obligations.statement: Optionally change client stream-configuration requests to adapt to conditions.
obligations.condition: Application updates a selected supported field
obligations.notes: The public request path emits an exact changed advertised player preference with all active role state, retains it through deactivation/readdition and omits it with inactive player. Immutable artwork/visualizer requests are not relabelled as dynamic capabilities.

obligations.statement: Require integer server_transmitted and nonempty active player/visualizer targets, or omission for all such streams.
obligations.condition: Receiving stream/clear
obligations.notes: All eight active stream subsets are crossed with omitted and every explicit target subset. Integer timestamp, missing/null/wrong-type fields, empty/duplicate/unsupported/inactive targets and artwork prohibition are asserted before mutation. Valid clear retains lifetimes, resets only selected decoder/visualizer state and leaves untargeted artwork intact.

obligations.statement: Do not send clear when no targeted streams are active.
obligations.condition: Sending stream/clear
obligations.notes: Cannot be used to open an inactive stream.

obligations.statement: Optionally include implemented application-specific stream roles in clear targets.
obligations.condition: The peers implement such a streaming role
obligations.notes: No application-specific roles are offered by this SDK.

obligations.statement: Treat ended streams as inactive immediately regardless of any role-specific buffered completion.
obligations.condition: Receiving stream/end
obligations.notes: This SDK's supported roles clear on end; a role permitting drain would still lose active-stream status immediately.

obligations.statement: Stop output and clear ended-role buffers unless that role defines another completion behavior.
obligations.condition: Completing targeted supported stream lifetimes
obligations.notes: Software output/queue cancellation is tested, not actual acoustic stop latency.

obligations.statement: Require nonempty active end targets or omit targets to end all active server-to-client streams.
obligations.condition: Parsing stream/end target selection
obligations.notes: All active/target subsets, omission and malformed target lists are independently asserted. obligations.statement: Avoid stream commands on natural track transitions except an in-place configuration update.
obligations.condition: Continuing a media queue naturally
obligations.notes: Gapless/crossfade generation is a server media-engine responsibility, not a client stop/start workaround.

obligations.statement: Use stream/clear rather than stream/end for seeks and track jumps.
obligations.condition: Playback continues at another queue position
obligations.notes: End signals actual termination. One continuous queue lifetime, not a stream per track.

obligations.statement: Do not send stream/end when no server-to-client stream is active.
obligations.condition: Ending streams
obligations.notes: Explicit targets must themselves have active streams.

obligations.statement: Optionally include implemented application-specific stream roles in end targets.
obligations.condition: Peers implement an application-specific stream
obligations.notes: Unadvertised custom stream output is outside selected client scope.

obligations.statement: Require all group/update fields and playback_state playing/stopped, replacing prior full group state.
obligations.condition: Receiving group/update even while unavailable
obligations.notes: Empty string ID/name are not rejected using invented nonempty constraints; caller snapshot ownership is separate.

obligations.statement: Promptly send group/update after first activation and every group field change.
obligations.condition: Publishing group state
obligations.notes: Receiver field validation cannot establish the server's change detection or timing.

obligations.statement: Delete only the matched long-term pairing record then send goodbye unpaired and close.
obligations.condition: Paired server/unpair on a permitted phase
obligations.notes: No activity-set requirement; handshake/rekey barriers still apply. Persistence errors cannot be generically rolled back remotely.

obligations.statement: Ignore server/unpair on an unpaired session without touching other records or identity.
obligations.condition: A Sentinel/pairing-key session sends unpair
obligations.notes: A following same-direction marker proves continued usability and no Store.Save.

obligations.statement: Remove the server's corresponding record when initiating unpair.
obligations.condition: A paired server elects to forget this client
obligations.notes: Not a second record deletion performed by the client SDK.

obligations.statement: Use one of the defined reason strings for client/goodbye.
obligations.condition: Sending a graceful client disconnect
obligations.notes: All eight defined reasons have exact encrypted payloads; a production reason-vocabulary guard rejects undefined internal reasons before any wire emission and fails invalid failGoodbye with ErrProtocol. Restart/user_request serialization does not imply adding a new public lifecycle API.

obligations.statement: Send shutdown on graceful shutdown when no more specific reason applies.
